messages:
alex: publish to us-ecr for service-c failed validation during release window. deploybot rejected manifest due to cosign timestamp mismatch. :grimacing:

deploy-bot: automated: Publish blocked for us-ecr.redwood/service-c@sha256:9b1a2f: cosign: signature timestamp 2026-03-19T23:58:00Z older than manifest timestamp 2026-03-20T00:05:00Z -> reject.

nadia: that sounds like CI clock skew on the ephemeral builder. we recently rotated build runners. could be unsynced NTP.

ops-oncall: for immediate mitigation we should pin staging to previous digest sha256:1a2b3c and lock auto-promote for the job.

release-engineer: Decision: hold the release window, pin staging and notify customers if >1h. Follow-up: rebuild with fresh signature after fixing runner time.

alex: locking now: `deploybot lock job=service-c-release reason="cosign timestamp mismatch"`

deploy-bot: automated: Lock applied for job=service-c-release by alex. Auto-promote disabled.

alex: pinning route: `deploybot pin route=staging/service-c digest=sha256:1a2b3c note="pin during timestamp fix"`

deploy-bot: automated: Route staging/service-c pinned to sha256:1a2b3c by alex. Pin expires in 12h.

nadia: I've patched runner images to enable ntp and queued a rebuild. ETA ~20m.

alex: rebuild completed, new digest sha256:c4d5e6. cosign and provenance lint passed. Promotion requires manual approve.

release-engineer: start canary at 5% for 10m. rollback plan: revert to sha256:1a2b3c if error rate >1%.

ops-oncall: canary healthy at +7m. unpin and unlock after promote.

alex: `deploybot unpin route=staging/service-c` && `deploybot unlock job=service-c-release`

deploy-bot: automated: Route staging/service-c unpinned by alex. Job service-c-release unlocked.

release-engineer: release window resumed. filing follow-up INF ticket to add a CI pre-lint for cosign timestamp vs manifest to fail fast."
